added: Importing a Caller's Companion .USR file now brings its custom columns across as custom fields, one per column name and filled in on each dance, instead of lines in the calling notes. An existing text field with the same name is reused. Dances imported earlier keep the text in their notes.
fixed: Importing a dance again no longer clears the custom-field values you added to it since the last import.

added: `mapCallersCompanionDance` maps `CcDanceRecord.userFields` to text `CustomFieldValue`s under a placeholder field id; `CallersCompanionUsrImporter` (which now takes a `CustomFieldDefRepository`) matches or creates the definitions before the dances commit and reverts them on failure and on `undo` (#1890). Keys come from `ccUserFieldKeyForLabel`/`planCcUserFields`; new definitions are text and shareable.
fixed: `ImportPipeline.commit` keeps a re-imported or linked dance's existing custom-field values for fields the draft does not carry, instead of deleting them through `DanceRepository.update`.
